decisions.action:
Build a complete, real-time SQF Edition 9 & FSMA Rule 204 compliant Critical Control Point (CCP) and Electronic Batch Recording (EBR) operating system. 

The system must satisfy the following integrated modules:
1. APEX Vision Circuit Integration: Ingest high-speed RTSP camera streams from 12 processing lines to monitor metal detector rejection loops, tamper-evident seal integrity, and allergen sanitation validation via real-time bounding box telemetry. Trigger hard-stop interlocks on line PLCs if three consecutive non-conformances occur.
2. FSMA Rule 204 Key Data Elements (KDEs) & Critical Tracking Events (CTEs): Auto-generate and cryptographically hash digital chain-of-custody ledgers for high-risk foods (HRFs) across receiving, transformation, and shipping, publishing immutable ASN records to a local PostgreSQL ledger with zero token waste.
3. Multi-Agent Governance Committee: Implement a pre-inference governance filter running under E.I.M.E.R.S. standards where no batch release certificate can be authorized without simultaneous automated sign-off from QA, Maintenance, and Sanitation agents—enforcing zero self-certification and hard-stopping ambiguous sensor inputs into a quarantine hold state.
4. Live Operator UX: A React/Next.js dashboard with role-based access control displaying live OEE, active CCP deviation alerts, and a voice-command override log authenticated via local Ollama Llama 3.3 execution.
